Monthly GST Component Mix

Source: R/collection.R
gst_component_mix.Rd

Monthly share (%) of CGST, SGST, IGST, and Cess in total collection for a given state or nationally.

gst_component_mix(state = NULL, financial_year = NULL)

Arguments

state

character(1). State name. NULL = national aggregate.

financial_year

character vector. NULL = all.

Value

A data.table with month_date, cgst_pct, sgst_pct, igst_pct, cess_pct.

Examples

gst_component_mix(state = "Gujarat", financial_year = "2023-24")
#>     month_date cgst_pct sgst_pct igst_pct cess_pct
